title: Shy
synopsis: Earth was on the brink of a third World War when super-powered individuals came forth from each country around the globe, ending the conflict and ushering in a new era of relative peace. Among those heroes, Japan is represented by a timid young girl known as “Shy.” She may spend more time worrying about her own shortcomings than she does battling villains, but she’ll show the world that despite it all she still has the heart of a hero! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

title: KaguRai: Kagura to Raito
synopsis: Kagura is a samurai girl known as the "Sword Saint" for her mastery of the way of the sword. And Raito is a boy who belongs to a race called "Hito-youkai" that is hated by the people. The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends. Until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! A one-shot story in the Sunday magazine received such a great response that it has been decided to serialize it! A Japanese-Western mixed fantasy with overwhelming brushwork that will rush out into the world! The start of this story!! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title: Ruri no Houseki
synopsis: Mineral collecting is like a modern-day treasure hunt! Ruri, a high school girl who loves jewelry and accessories, gets into the world of mineral collecting, venturing into mountains, rivers, and caves. The first volume features numerous minerals, including quartz, garnet, pyrite, gold sand, and fluorite. The manga is full of fascinating scenes focusing on specialized tools such as a panning dish, hammer, and topographical maps. An authentic scientific adventure based on the author's solid knowledge of mineralogy! (Source: Harta, translated)

title: Tsumi to Batsu no Spica
synopsis: Hatori is an ordinary teacher leading an ordinary life at an ordinary high school. One day, he notices that one of his students, Spica Tsumugi, is being bullied. On his way home from school, he ends up alone with Tsumugi in the rain. Hatori calls out to her, “Sensei will help you!" But Tsumugi gently takes his hand and says with a smile, “Hatori-sensei is such a liar." Teacher and student… two people who should not get too close. The seductive girl that will turn Hatori's ordinary life upside down… (Source: Kodansha, translated)

synopsis: One day, Arthur realizes that he’s been reincarnated as the villain in a BL game. On top of that, he remembers that based on the plot of the game, he only has endings like the “Imprisonment Ending” and “Tentacle Ending” waiting for him! With no other option to save his chastity and life, his only way out is getting his fiancée to get with the protagonist! Dragging along his trusty servant Edgar, he tries to craft up schemes to get the two of them together. But, rather than being hated as the villain, he starts raising BL flags of his own?! (Source: Kodansha, translated)
